zh: 给长度为 i 的前缀整体加 x，只会改变第 i 个与第 i+1 个元素之间的差，其余相邻差都不变。
所有元素相等等价于每个相邻差都变成 0，消掉一个差至少要付出它的绝对值；从后往前逐个把前缀调到右邻的值，正好付出这个下界。
读入数组，累加所有相邻元素差的绝对值并输出；总和可达约 4·10^14，要用 64 位整数。
en: Adding x to the prefix of length i changes only the difference between elements i and i+1; every other adjacent difference stays the same.

All elements are equal exactly when every adjacent difference is 0, and erasing one difference costs at least its absolute value; adjusting prefixes from right to left to match their right neighbor pays exactly this lower bound.
Read the array, add up the absolute differences of all adjacent pairs, and print the sum; it can reach about 4·10^14, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

The answer is the sum of the absolute differences between adjacent elements.

## Proof of correctness

An operation on the prefix of length i only affects the i-th adjacent difference; all other adjacent differences stay the same. Eliminating that difference costs at least its absolute value, so the sum over all boundaries is a lower bound. Working from back to front and adjusting each prefix to the value of its right neighbor pays exactly this sum, reaching the lower bound; shifting the whole array does not affect equality and is never needed.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) space apart from the input.
